blocks.text: 昏暗的路燈 安靜的夜景
blocks.spelling: hūn àm-iánn ê lōo-ting an-tsīng ê iā-kíng

blocks.text: 冷風伴花蕊 憂愁留予阮 啊
blocks.spelling: líng-hong phuānn hue-luí iu-tshiû lâu hōo gún ah

blocks.text: 月光下的暗暝 無緣故想起你
blocks.spelling: gue̍h-kng hā ê àm-mî bô-iân kòo siūnn-khí lí

blocks.text: 倔強提袂出勇氣來問你
blocks.spelling: khut-kiông thê buē tshut ióng-khì lâi mn̄g lí

blocks.text: 你過了如何 踮佇青份的所在 敢會孤單
blocks.spelling: lí kuè-liáu lû-hô tiàm tī tshenn hūn ê sóo-tsāi kám-ē koo-tuann

blocks.text: 我所失去的笑容也會綴你轉來
blocks.spelling: guá sóo sit-khì ê tshiò-iông iā ē tuè lí tńg-lâi
